_purpose: Permission-aware retrieval leak evals. Hand-labeled cases over the FIXTURE corpus (agent/fixtures/permission_docs/, clearly fake stand-ins for Notion/Slack pages) plus the public curated slice. A case FAILS if a caller role is shown a chunk above its access level. `forbidden_sources` must never appear for `role`. `unfiltered_top_role`, when set, proves the forbidden doc really is the closest semantic match for that query (rank 1 for the higher role), so a pass means the doc was withheld, not merely out-ranked. Zero tolerance: any failing case fails the build. Run: python agent/eval_runner.py permission
